profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience in full stack mobile/web app development, NLP, and more.  
I have a passion for machine learning, AI, and digital assistants. 

Specialties & Skills (just to name a few): 
Programming Language: Java,C++, JS, Python, Perl, Shell script, PHP, HTML, R
Data Management Tools: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Berkeley DB
Distributed Tools: Hadoop, Apache Crunch, Cassandra
Webdev Tools/Frameworks: JS(ES5/ES6), ReactJS, jQuery, Node.js, AngularJS, Gulp
Data Analysis/Visualization Tools: R, Python Packages(Numpy, Theano, Caffe, Lasagne), D3js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Using react, redux, node, docker, docker-compose, and aws to build tools that help our researchers perform predictive analytics an share results at an enterprise level. 
* Playing with draft.js, Koa2, ES 6-7, redux sagas, docker-swarm.
* Designed and built the full stack from java/python to node, react/redux, implemented containers as well as branching strategies, testing and CI

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op/Intern
positions.description:
* In (successful) attempt to provide the ability to consolidate data requests, I was also tasked with building a website using ReatJS
* Helped in designing and developing a web search application utilizing Elasticsearch which helped enhance performance when filtering the search results. Also used Javascript, Django, and JQuery for better UX
